text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We came to the shrine together, but for 
some reason, Inari One changed into geta 
clogs.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, we're gonna come face to face with 
God. We've gotta make proper preparations 
on our end too!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Clogs clacking, tossing a coin into the 
offering box, ringing the bell vigorously, 
clapping loudly, and praying with all 
one's heart from deep within.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
When you make a wish with a good attitude, 
even the gods are more inclined to grant 
it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And with that, time to make a wish!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Inari One began offering her prayers.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gods! Please! To a hopeless bum like me, 
fire up my spirit with a good kick!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright! We're good with this! All that's 
left is to put in some honest-to-goodness 
hard work!

text_block_list.name: Dashing Middle-Aged Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wearing geta to visit the shrine—how 
stylish. Praying for victory? I'll be 
rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Man, I can't be putting on an unsightly 
run out there! I gotta train like crazy 
and make a huge splash!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One adopted a positive mindset, and 
after that, she truly regained her groove!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well then, how about we get something good 
to eat—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ah! The strap on my geta broke!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And right after paying my respects to the 
gods, no less... What an ominous sign...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well now, looks like I just wasn't chic 
enough, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One grew discouraged and remained 
out of shape after that...
